title: Icon route
description: How a game's Icon Pack is built: where the item data comes from, where the pixels come from and which mapping module joins them. Optional in a game record.

game.description: The pack directory and the game identifier Takaro looks the pack up by.

decoder.description: A decoder container that reads the data files. Absent means an in-process parser.

input.description: The target's steam-depots input the data files come from.

depots.description: A subset of that input's depots; every depot of the input when absent.

files.description: DepotDownloader file-list selectors: an exact path, or regex: with a case-insensitive pattern.

access.description: files: the listed files are read whole. iostore-ranges: the listed .utoc files are read whole and only the .ucas byte ranges that hold the needed packages are copied.

files.description: Exact client-relative paths in precedence order: a name held by several is taken from the first listed. With access iostore-ranges only .utoc paths; their .ucas files are derived.

clientBuilds.description: Target revision to the client build ids of the same release.

engine.description: The CUE4Parse EGame value that reads this game's containers.

aesKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the containers' AES key; null for unencrypted games. Never the key itself.

unreal.description: Settings of the unreal decoder; required exactly when a role uses it.

secrets.description: Names of environment variables the build reads; never their values.
